scripts.predev: npm run build --workspace @nero/shared && npm run build --workspace @nero/player
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --workspace @nero/server" "npm run dev --workspace @nero/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nero/shared && npm run build --workspace @nero/player && npm run build --workspace @nero/server && npm run build --workspace @nero/web && npm run build --workspace @nero/discord-bot && npm run build --workspace @nero/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @nero/shared && npm run build --workspace @nero/player && npm run typecheck --workspace @nero/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @nero/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @nero/discord-bot && npm run typecheck --workspace @nero/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @nero/shared && npm run test --workspace @nero/player && npm run test --workspace @nero/server
